title: Matching and Price Competition in Large Markets
title_zh: 大规模市场中的匹配与价格竞争
title_primary: 大规模市场中的匹配与价格竞争
title_secondary: Matching and Price Competition in Large Markets
authors: Bingchao Huangfu, Gagan Ghosh, Heng Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-09-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the large market implications of impersonal wage competition. There are finitely many categories of firms and workers, and firms compete for workers by offering uniform wages. We first characterize the unique mixed strategy Nash equilibrium of large replica economies with supermodular preferences. Competition is local: firms only compete with others like themselves, either within the same category or one category above. As the market size grows, the equilibrium converges rapidly to the firm-optimal competitive equilibrium. For general preferences, Nash equilibria converge to competitive equilibria as the market becomes arbitrarily large. We identify a condition on preferences which ensures that the limiting equilibria differ from the firm-optimal competitive equilibrium. Our analysis highlights how the interaction between preference structure and pricing flexibility governs whether uniform wage posting leads to suppressed or inflated wages in large markets.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了非人格化工资竞争在大市场中的含义。存在有限类别的企业和工人，企业通过提供统一工资来竞争工人。我们首先刻画了具有超模偏好的大型复制经济中唯一的混合策略纳什均衡。竞争是局部性的：企业仅与同类企业竞争，要么在同一类别内，要么在上一类别中。随着市场规模的增长，均衡迅速收敛至企业最优竞争均衡。对于一般偏好，当市场变得任意大时，纳什均衡收敛至竞争均衡。我们识别了一个关于偏好的条件，该条件确保极限均衡不同于企业最优竞争均衡。我们的分析强调了偏好结构与定价灵活性之间的相互作用如何决定统一工资报价在大市场中导致工资被抑制还是膨胀。

title: DP21173 Geopolitics in the Evaluation of International Scientific Collaboration
title_zh: 国际科学合作评估中的地缘政治因素
title_primary: 国际科学合作评估中的地缘政治因素
title_secondary: DP21173 Geopolitics in the Evaluation of International Scientific Collaboration
authors: Alexander Furnas, Ruixue Jia, Margaret Roberts, Dashun Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-02-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study provides evidence that geopolitical considerations systematically shape funding evaluations of international collaboration proposals. We examine this dynamic in the consequential context of U.S.–China collaboration. Across two large-scale randomized experiments with U.S. policymakers and U.S.-based scientists, we find substantial and consistent penalties for proposals involving China-based collaborators. Policymakers express much greater unconditional support for proposals with Germany-based collaborators than for otherwise identical proposals with China-based collaborators (68% vs. 28%). Crucially, this penalty is not confined to policymakers: scientists themselves exhibit a sizeable 18 percentage-point gap (48% vs. 30%), despite professional expectations of merit-based evaluation. Much of the difference reflects a shift from unconditional to conditional approval rather than outright rejection. These penalties are remarkably consistent across scientific fields and respondent characteristics, with little evidence of heterogeneity, indicating that they reflect geopolitical rather than domain-specific concerns. Overall, the findings suggest that geopolitics influences gatekeeping judgments in government funding, with broad implications for peer review, scientific norms, and the future of international collaboration in an era of intensifying geopolitical competition.
abstract_zh: 本研究提供证据表明，地缘政治考量系统性地影响了对国际合作提案的资助评估。我们在中美合作这一重要背景下考察了这一动态。通过对美国政策制定者及美国本土科学家进行的两项大规模随机实验，我们发现涉及中国合作者的提案遭受了显著且一致的惩罚。政策制定者对涉及德国合作者的提案所表达的无条件支持远高于对条件相同但涉及中国合作者的提案（68%对比28%）。至关重要的是，这种惩罚并不仅限于政策制定者：科学家自身也表现出高达18个百分点的差距（48%对比30%），尽管专业规范期望基于绩效的评估。这一差异大部分反映了从无条件批准向有条件批准的转变，而非直接否决。这些惩罚在不同科学领域及受访者特征中表现出高度一致性，几乎没有异质性的证据，表明它们反映的是地缘政治关切而非特定领域的问题。总体而言，研究结果表明，地缘政治影响着政府资助中的把关判断，对同行评审、科学规范以及在地缘政治竞争日益激烈的时代国际合作的未来具有广泛启示。

title: Bank Capital Requirements and Bank Lending: From Theory to Empirics to Policy

title_primary: 银行资本要求与银行贷款：从理论到实证再到政策
title_secondary: Bank Capital Requirements and Bank Lending: From Theory to Empirics to Policy
authors: Saleem Bahaj, Chiara Lattanzio, Frédéric Malherbe
official: 官方在线 2025-02-14 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper, we provide a comprehensive analysis of how changes in capital requirements affect bank lending. We use a theoretical framework to assess and nuance the trade-off. We show that imperfect competition, general equilibrium effects, and asset heterogeneity among banks result in lending responses that are complex and difficult to estimate. Armed with these theoretical insights, we assess existing strategies in the empirical literature and provide guidance for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文全面分析了资本要求变化如何影响银行放贷。我们运用理论框架来评估并细化这一权衡关系。研究表明，不完全竞争、一般均衡效应以及银行间资产异质性导致放贷反应复杂且难以估计。基于这些理论洞见，我们评估了实证文献中的现有策略，并为未来研究提供指导。

title: Contingent plea agreements for witness testimony
title_zh: 证人证言的附条件认罪协议
title_primary: 证人证言的附条件认罪协议
title_secondary: Contingent plea agreements for witness testimony
authors: Frances Xu Lee, Abraham L Wickelgren
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A prosecutor can offer leniency to an eyewitness in exchange for testimony. There is a concern that allowing the prosecutor to make the leniency contingent upon a successful conviction will produce more perjury and the court has thrown out some testimony obtained through such contingent agreements. This article uses a Bayesian jury model to examine the impact of allowing a conviction-motivated prosecutor to design a contingent scheme. It finds that the impact of allowing contingency on the Type 1 error of innocent conviction and the Type 2 error of wrongful acquittal depends on the precision of the additional evidence in the trial. In particular, when the additional evidence is very precise, allowing contingency may reduce both errors. Under a properly designed limit on the amount of leniency, allowing contingency can reduce both innocent conviction and wrongful acquittal.
abstract_zh: 检察官可以向目击证人提供宽大处理以换取证词。然而，允许检察官将宽大处理与成功定罪挂钩，可能引发更多伪证问题，法院已因此否决了部分通过此类附条件协议获取的证词。本文运用贝叶斯陪审团模型，探讨允许以定罪为动机的检察官设计附条件方案的影响。研究发现，允许附条件协议对无辜者定罪的第一类错误和错误无罪释放的第二类错误的影响，取决于审判中额外证据的精确度。特别是，当额外证据非常精确时，允许附条件协议可能同时减少这两类错误。在适当设计宽大处理限度的情况下，允许附条件协议能够同时降低无辜者定罪和错误无罪释放的发生率。

title: Evolution of Discrimination on Online Platforms
title_zh: 在线平台歧视的演变
title_primary: 在线平台歧视的演变
title_secondary: Evolution of Discrimination on Online Platforms
authors: Peibo Zhang, Xinyu Cao, Ruomeng Cui, Dennis J. Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Research on discrimination has predominantly relied on audit studies, which provide clean causal estimates through randomized profile testing but offer only static snapshots of bias. We adopt a dynamic perspective to examine how racial discrimination evolves over time. Using observational panel data from an online educational platform, we first find that African-American teachers receive 30.2% fewer bookings, and their opened classes are 3.3% less likely to be booked compared with their White counterparts during their first week on the platform, a gap that may indicate initial discrimination. Employing individual fixed effects models, we estimate how this gap evolves over time. The results show a striking 1,007% widening of the initial gap over the 12-week period. Our mechanism analysis shows that new students are significantly less likely to book classes with African-American teachers than with White teachers, even when African-American and White teachers have minimal or comparable reputation metrics. As a result, African-American teachers accumulate reputation metrics and customers more slowly than White teachers. Over time, the growing gaps in reputation and customer base further exacerbate the booking gap, driven by both new and repeat students. Our findings suggest that traditional audit studies may significantly underestimate the long-term consequences of early-stage discrimination and highlight how reputation and repeat customer accumulation serve as bias amplifiers on online platforms. We also show that this amplification mechanism operates regardless of whether the initial gap stems from racial discrimination and thus generalizes to other contexts. This paper was accepted by Srikanth Jagabathula, market design, platform, and demand analytics. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02111 .
abstract_zh: 关于歧视的研究主要依赖于审计研究，这种方法通过随机化档案测试提供了干净的因果估计，但仅能捕捉到偏见的静态快照。我们采用动态视角来考察种族歧视如何随时间演变。利用来自在线教育平台的观测面板数据，我们首先发现，非洲裔美国教师在平台上的第一周内，其预约次数比白人教师少30.2%，且其开设的课程被预订的可能性低3.3%，这一差距可能表明初始歧视的存在。通过使用个体固定效应模型，我们估计了这一差距随时间的变化情况。结果显示，在12周期间，初始差距惊人地扩大了1007%。我们的机制分析表明，新学生显著更不可能预订非洲裔美国教师的课程，而非白人教师的课程，即使当非洲裔美国教师和白人教师拥有最小或相当的信誉指标时也是如此。因此，非洲裔美国教师积累信誉指标和客户的速度慢于白人教师。随着时间推移，信誉和客户基础的日益扩大差距进一步加剧了预订差距，这既受到新学生也受到重复学生的影响。我们的研究结果表明，传统的审计研究可能显著低估了早期歧视的长期后果，并强调了信誉和重复客户积累如何作为在线平台上的偏见放大器。我们还表明，无论初始差距是否源于种族歧视，这种放大机制都会运作，因此可推广至其他情境。本文已被Srikanth Jagabathula接受，涉及市场设计、平台和需求分析。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02111获取。

title: The geography of commodity booms
title_zh: 大宗商品繁荣的地理分布
title_primary: 大宗商品繁荣的地理分布
title_secondary: The geography of commodity booms
authors: Luis Baldomero-Quintana
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I investigate how local commodity booms impact regional manufacturing in Colombia. I build a multisectoral economic geography model with industry linkages where states trade domestically and internationally. I quantify the spatial spillovers to manufacturing under several local resource boom scenarios, finding three key results. First, states that have both high domestic and international market access tend to see an increase in their manufacturing activity under booms, while less-connected states see a decline. Second, domestic trade and industry linkages can amplify or reduce these manufacturing spillovers. Third, international trade is the main determinant of the spatial spillovers to manufacturing. I also find that local commodity booms produce four patterns: (i) they crowd out manufacturing activity in the state where the boom occurs, (ii) their spatial spillovers to manufacturing change when I eliminate labor mobility frictions, (iii) they increase production costs in manufacturing sectors, and (iv) they induce worker reallocation across sectors. My findings show that geography, trade, and industry linkages crucially determine how commodity booms shape regional industrialization in developing nations.
abstract_zh: 我研究了地方大宗商品繁荣如何影响哥伦比亚的区域制造业。我构建了一个包含产业关联的多部门经济地理模型，其中各州在国内和国际上进行贸易。我量化了几种地方资源繁荣情景下对制造业的空间溢出效应，发现了三个关键结果。首先，在国内和国际市场准入方面均较高的州，在繁荣时期往往会出现制造业活动的增长，而连通性较差的州则会出现下降。其次，国内贸易和产业关联可以放大或缩小这些制造业溢出效应。第三，国际贸易是决定制造业空间溢出效应的主要因素。我还发现，地方大宗商品繁荣产生了四种模式：（i）它们挤出了繁荣发生州的制造业活动，（ii）当我消除劳动力流动摩擦时，其对制造业的空间溢出效应发生变化，（iii）它们提高了制造业部门的生产成本，以及（iv）它们引发了工人跨部门的重新配置。我的研究结果表明，地理、贸易和产业关联在决定大宗商品繁荣如何塑造发展中国家区域工业化方面至关重要。

title: Monetary Transmission to Firm-level R&D
title_zh: 货币政策传导对企业层面研发的影响
title_primary: 货币政策传导对企业层面研发的影响
title_secondary: Monetary Transmission to Firm-level R&D
authors: Ruslana Datsenko, Martin Blomhoff Holm
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Monetary policy is usually evaluated through its effect on aggregate output and inflation, with less attention to how it reallocates innovative investment across firms. Existing evidence shows that higher rates reduce innovation, but the firms driving this response remain unclear. Combining Norway’s R&D survey with administrative data and narrative monetary shocks for 2001–2018, we estimate heterogeneous firm responses. Contractionary policy reduces R&D most in high-growth firms with recent equity issuance, consistent with asset-price channels of monetary transmission. Standard debt-based measures explain little heterogeneity. Monetary policy therefore has long-run real effects primarily through its effects on R&D in high-growth firms.
abstract_zh: 货币政策通常通过其对总产出和通货膨胀的影响来评估，而较少关注其如何在企业间重新配置创新投资。现有证据表明，较高的利率会减少创新，但驱动这一反应的企业类型尚不明确。结合挪威的研发调查、行政数据以及2001-2018年间的叙事性货币冲击，我们估计了企业的异质性反应。紧缩性政策对近期有股权发行的高增长企业的研发削减最为显著，这与货币传导的资产价格渠道相符。基于债务的标准指标对异质性的解释力有限。因此，货币政策主要通过其对高增长企业研发的影响产生长期实际效应。

title: Threshold Regression with Errors-in-Variables
title_zh: 带测量误差的门槛回归
title_primary: 带测量误差的门槛回归
title_secondary: Threshold Regression with Errors-in-Variables
authors: Yiguo Sun
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a novel generalized method of moments (GMM) estimator for linear threshold regression models with a mismeasured regressor and an exogenous threshold variable. The estimator addresses a key challenge in empirical applications: identifying model parameters in the absence of valid external instruments for the mismeasured regressor. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed estimator and develop test statistics for detecting threshold effects. Monte Carlo simulations show strong finite-sample performance, and an empirical application to firm investment equations highlights the practical relevance of the method.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的广义矩估计（GMM）方法，用于处理带有测量误差回归变量和外生阈值变量的线性阈值回归模型。该估计器解决了实证应用中的一个关键挑战：在缺乏针对测量误差回归变量的有效外部工具时，如何识别模型参数。我们确立了所提估计量的一致性和渐近正态性，并开发了用于检测阈值效应的检验统计量。蒙特卡洛模拟显示了良好的有限样本性能，而对企业投资方程式的实证应用则凸显了该方法的实际相关性。

title_zh: 应用条件行为法于区域层面

authors: Oliver Becker, Tobias Börger, Jürgen Meyerhoff
official: 官方在线 2026-04-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Abstract Contingent behavior (CB) studies typically analyze changes in recreation demand at single sites by presenting identical scenarios to all respondents. This prevents assessing demand responses under diverse future conditions and across broader spatial scales. The present study applies the CB method using a general population survey, integrating self-reported site characteristics with an experimental design to define CB scenarios. This allows recreation demand to be modeled as a function of multiple environmental attributes and analyzed regionally but requires adjusting the prediction procedure. Using data on forest recreation in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany, we propose approaches for site- and region-level predictions.
abstract_zh: 条件行为（CB）研究通常通过向所有受访者呈现相同的情景，来分析单一地点的休闲需求变化。这阻碍了在不同未来条件及更广泛空间尺度下评估需求响应的能力。本研究采用一般人口调查应用CB方法，将自我报告的场地特征与实验设计相结合以定义CB情景。这使得休闲需求能够作为多种环境属性的函数进行建模，并在区域层面进行分析，但需要对预测程序进行调整。利用德国梅克伦堡-前波莫瑞州的森林休闲数据，我们提出了场地级和区域级预测的方法。JEL分类号：Q51Q26

title: Monetary policy transmission under supply-chain disruptions: Evidence from a time-varying BVAR
title_zh: 供应链中断下的货币政策传导：来自时变BVAR的证据
title_primary: 供应链中断下的货币政策传导：来自时变BVAR的证据

authors: Sungjun Huh, Insu Kim
official: 官方在线 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the time-varying effects of monetary policy and global supply-chain disruptions on U.S. inflation and GDP during the COVID-19 pandemic. To this end, we estimate a time-varying parameter Bayesian Vector Autoregressive (TVP-BVAR) model. We find that expansionary monetary policy shocks’ impact differs significantly between pre- and post-pandemic periods. Specifically, inflationary effects of supply-chain disruptions increased substantially after the pandemic, while output effects remained stable. Furthermore, monetary policy pass-through to inflation strengthens as supply-chain pressures intensify. Finally, statistical evidence shows that supply-chain disruptions steepen the Phillips curve, with the effect most pronounced for durable goods inflation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了新冠疫情期间货币政策与全球供应链中断对美国通胀及GDP的时变影响。为此，我们估计了一个时变参数贝叶斯向量自回归（TVP-BVAR）模型。研究发现，扩张性货币政策冲击的影响在疫情前后时期存在显著差异。具体而言，供应链中断的通胀效应在疫情后大幅增强，而产出效应则保持稳定。此外，随着供应链压力的加剧，货币政策向通胀的传导效应增强。最后，统计证据表明，供应链中断使菲利普斯曲线变得更加陡峭，且这一效应在耐用品通胀中最为显著。

title: Using Machine Learning to Generate, Clarify, and Improve Economic Models
title_zh: 使用机器学习生成、澄清和改进经济模型
title_primary: 使用机器学习生成、澄清和改进经济模型
title_secondary: Using Machine Learning to Generate, Clarify, and Improve Economic Models
authors: Liang, Annie
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This article examines how machine learning and other computational techniques can contribute to the development of economic models. First, comparing economic models to flexible algorithms can help clarify the strengths and limitations of existing models, for instance how far they are from the predictive limit. Second, algorithms can adversarially probe economic models to identify cases in which the theoretical predictions fail. Third, “hybrid” models can combine interpretable economic structure with flexible learning methods to leverage the strengths of both. Finally, large language models introduce qualitatively new possibilities, from simulating human responses to generating novel hypotheses. Throughout, I emphasize both promise and limits: while machine learning can uncover patterns that standard models miss, translating these algorithmic insights into interpretable and portable economic understanding typically still requires human judgment.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨机器学习及其他计算技术如何推动经济模型的发展。首先，将经济模型与灵活算法进行比较，有助于厘清现有模型的优势与局限，例如其与预测极限之间的差距。其次，算法可通过对抗性方式检验经济模型，识别理论预测失效的案例。第三，“混合”模型能够将可解释的经济结构与灵活的学习方法相结合，从而发挥两者的优势。最后，大语言模型带来了质的新可能性，从模拟人类反应到生成新颖假设。全文始终强调前景与局限并存：尽管机器学习能发现标准模型遗漏的模式，但将这些算法洞见转化为可解释且可迁移的经济学理解，通常仍需依赖人类判断。

title: Hospital Billing Regulations and Financial Well-being: Evidence from California’s Fair Pricing Law
title_zh: 医院计费法规与财务福祉：来自加州公平定价法的证据
title_primary: 医院计费法规与财务福祉：来自加州公平定价法的证据
title_secondary: Hospital Billing Regulations and Financial Well-being: Evidence from California’s Fair Pricing Law
authors: Yaa Akosa Antwi, Marion Aouad, Nathan Blascak
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the financial consequences of the 2007 California Fair Pricing Law, which places a price ceiling on hospital bills for financially vulnerable individuals. Using cross-sectional variation in exposure to the law, proxied by county-level uninsured rates, we estimate its impact on individual financial outcomes. We find that the law reduces the likelihood of incurring non-medical debt in collections and the number of non-medical accounts in collections. In addition, we find evidence that credit scores increased and suggestive evidence that the number of delinquent accounts decreased for individuals in more exposed counties. Our results suggest hospital billing regulations can improve targeted individuals’ financial outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了2007年加州公平定价法对财务脆弱人群医院账单设置价格上限所产生的财务后果。利用法律暴露程度的横截面差异，以县级未保险率作为代理指标，我们评估了该法律对个人财务结果的影响。研究发现，该法律降低了产生非医疗债务催收的可能性及非医疗催收账户的数量。此外，证据显示，在暴露程度更高的县，个人信用评分有所提升，且拖欠账户数量减少的迹象也较为明显。我们的结果表明，医院账单规定能够改善目标人群的财务状况。

title: Coordination in the network minimum game
title_zh: 网络最小博弈中的协调
title_primary: 网络最小博弈中的协调
title_secondary: Coordination in the network minimum game
authors: Johannes C. Hoelzemann, Hongyi Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Motivated by the problem of organizational design, we study coordination in the network minimum game : a version of the minimum-effort game where players are connected by a directed network. We show experimentally that acyclic networks such as hierarchies are most conducive to successful coordination. Introducing a single link to complete a network cycle may drastically inhibit coordination. Furthermore, acyclic networks enable resilient coordination: initial coordination failure is often overcome (exacerbated) after repeated play in acyclic (cyclic) networks.
abstract_zh: 受组织设计问题的启发，我们研究了网络最小博弈中的协调问题：该博弈是最小努力博弈的一个变体，其中参与者通过有向网络相互连接。实验结果表明，层级结构等无环网络最有利于实现成功协调。引入单一链接以形成网络环可能会严重抑制协调。此外，无环网络能够实现具有韧性的协调：在无环（有环）网络中，初始协调失败往往会在重复博弈后被克服（加剧）。

title: Designing Contracts for the Energy Transition
title_zh: 设计能源转型的合同
title_primary: 设计能源转型的合同
title_secondary: Designing Contracts for the Energy Transition
authors: Natalia Fabra, Gerard Llobet, William Parker, Johannes Spinnewijn, Fernanda Ortega 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-05 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the limitations of spot markets in providing adequate investment incentives to support zero-carbon investments in electricity markets. In contrast, properly designed long-term contracts have the potential to mitigate price volatility and facilitate the funding of the investments. A theoretical model is developed to analyze contract design under conditions of moral hazard and adverse selection, emphasizing the trade-offs that arise when exposing firms to price and quantity risk. The findings inform optimal contract design for nuclear and renewable energy projects, offering policy recommendations to enhance investment incentives while minimizing productive inefficiencies and excessive rents.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了现货市场在提供充足投资激励以支持电力市场零碳投资方面的局限性。相比之下，设计得当的长期合同具有缓解价格波动并促进投资融资的潜力。本文构建了一个理论模型，用于分析道德风险和逆向选择条件下的合同设计，重点揭示了企业在面临价格与数量风险时所产生的权衡关系。研究结论为核能与可再生能源项目的最优合同设计提供了依据，并提出了相关政策建议，以在增强投资激励的同时，减少生产效率损失与超额租金。

title: Data element sharing and manufacturing-service integration: evidence from China
title_zh: 数据要素共享与制造服务融合：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 数据要素共享与制造服务融合：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Data element sharing and manufacturing-service integration: evidence from China
authors: Tiancheng Qi, Yongfan Ma
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Exploiting the establishment of public data platforms in China as a quasi-natural experiment, this paper systematically examines the impact of public data on the integration of manufacturing and service industries (MSI). We find that public data openness significantly promotes MSI. Mechanism analysis identifies two transmission channels through which public data openness promotes MSI. These channels are enterprise digital-intelligent transformation and high-skilled labour matching. We further find that the local market and institutional environment moderates this effect. The promotional impact is stronger in cities whose market and institutional environments are weaker. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that among various categories of public data, data pertaining to government services, market regulation, and fiscal and financial affairs exhibits a more pronounced promotional effect. The promotional effect is stronger in cities with more developed digital infrastructure and in non-resource-based cities. This study offers key policy implications for deepening public data openness and empowering regional industrial structure upgrading within the context of the digital economy.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国公共数据平台设立为准自然实验，系统考察了公共数据对制造业与服务业融合（MSI）的影响。研究发现，公共数据开放显著促进了制造业与服务业融合。机制分析揭示了公共数据开放促进产业融合的两条传导渠道：企业数智化转型与高技能劳动力匹配。进一步研究表明，本地市场与制度环境对该效应具有调节作用——在市场与制度环境较弱的城市，其促进效应更为显著。异质性分析显示，在各类公共数据中，政务服务、市场监管及财政金融类数据的促进效应尤为突出；数字基础设施更完善的城市及非资源型城市中，该促进效应更强。本研究为数字经济背景下深化公共数据开放、赋能区域产业结构升级提供了重要政策启示。

title: To be or not to be in Banking Union
title_zh: 是否加入银行业联盟
title_primary: 是否加入银行业联盟
title_secondary: To be or not to be in Banking Union
authors: Harris Dellas, Dimitris Papageorgiou
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Banking Union (BU) membership comes with costs, such as foregoing the ability to tailor domestic banking regulation to the country’s needs and preferences; and benefits, such as a more efficient provision of deposit insurance. We use a general equilibrium model that features a rich financial sector, risk shocks, optimal bank capital regulation and government-provided deposit insurance to evaluate the implications of BU membership for welfare, macroeconomic activity and financial stability. BU participation is favored by a riskier and more consequential --for economic activity-- banking sector. Nevertheless, there are cases of welfare improving membership that are not associated with higher and more stable macroeconomic performance and financial stability.
abstract_zh: 银行联盟（BU）成员身份既带来成本，例如放弃根据本国需求和偏好调整国内银行监管的能力；也带来收益，例如更高效的存款保险供给。我们采用包含复杂金融部门、风险冲击、最优银行资本监管及政府提供存款保险的一般均衡模型，评估BU成员身份对福利、宏观经济活动及金融稳定的影响。风险更高且对经济活动影响更显著的银行部门更倾向于加入BU。然而，存在福利改善型成员身份案例，其并未伴随更高且更稳定的宏观经济表现与金融稳定。

title: Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and their Aggregate Economic Implications
title_zh: 对顶层财富征税：迁移反应及其总体经济影响
title_primary: 对顶层财富征税：迁移反应及其总体经济影响
title_secondary: Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and their Aggregate Economic Implications
authors: Jakobsen, Katrine, Kleven, Henrik, Kolsrud, Jonas, Landais, Camille, Munoz, Mathilde
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using administrative data from Scandinavian countries, we provide evidence on international migration responses to wealth taxes and evaluate their aggregate economic implications. We find significant migration responses among the wealthy: a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate decreases the stock of wealthy taxpayers by about 2%. A large fraction of the wealthy are business owners, and their businesses are negatively affected by owner out-migration. The aggregate effects are nevertheless modest: the migration responses to a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate reduce employment by 0.02%, investments by 0.07%, and value-added by 0.10%.
abstract_zh: 利用斯堪的纳维亚国家的行政数据，我们提供了关于国际移民对财富税反应的证据，并评估了其总体经济影响。我们发现富裕群体存在显著的移民反应：最高财富税率每提高1个百分点，富裕纳税人存量约减少2%。大部分富裕群体为企业主，其企业因所有者外迁而受到负面影响。然而，总体效应较为温和：最高财富税率每提高1个百分点所引发的移民反应，导致就业减少0.02%，投资减少0.07%，增加值减少0.10%。

title: ‘Identify the Expert’: an Experimental Study in Economic Advice
title_zh: 识别专家”：经济建议的实验研究
title_primary: 识别专家”：经济建议的实验研究
title_secondary: ‘Identify the Expert’: an Experimental Study in Economic Advice
authors: Alysandratos, Theodore, Boukouras, Aris, Georganas, Sotiris, Maniadis, Zacharias
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In a novel ‘identify the Expert’ task, participants receive suggested answers by two advisors. They know one is high-accuracy and recommends answers reflecting the academic consensus (‘Expert’). The other is low-accuracy and recommends the modal answer from a sample of laypeople (‘Populist’). Participants are incentivized to identify the Expert. Yet, they overwhelmingly choose the Populist, even when they could always identify the Expert without using Bayesian reasoning. Overconfidence hampers decision making, but does not fully account for the low success rate. Bayesian models fail to explain these choices. These results are relevant for a wide range of expert selection problems.
abstract_zh: 在一项新颖的“识别专家”任务中，参与者会收到两位顾问提供的建议答案。他们知道其中一位准确率较高，且其推荐答案反映了学术共识（“专家”）；另一位准确率较低，推荐的是从普通民众样本中得出的众数答案（“民粹者”）。参与者被激励去识别专家。然而，他们绝大多数选择了民粹者，即便在不使用贝叶斯推理的情况下，他们本可以始终识别出专家。过度自信阻碍了决策，但并不能完全解释这种低成功率。贝叶斯模型无法解释这些选择。这些结果对广泛的专家选择问题具有启示意义。

title: Government Intervention in the Financial Market
title_zh: 政府对金融市场的干预
title_primary: 政府对金融市场的干预
title_secondary: Government Intervention in the Financial Market
authors: Jiang Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Government intervention in the financial market through its own trading fundamentally changes the market’s structure, function, and outcome. I develop a general equilibrium framework to study the impact of government trading on investor welfare. I show that with incompleteness and information asymmetry, the market equilibrium is in general suboptimal, and government intervention can potentially improve investor welfare even with no additional information. However, the actual welfare impact of government intervention is sensitive to the details of the economy and the policy design. Popular policy targets such as price stability, market liquidity, and informational efficiency can have different welfare implications.
abstract_zh: 政府通过自身交易对金融市场进行干预，从根本上改变了市场的结构、功能与结果。本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，研究政府交易对投资者福利的影响。研究表明，在市场不完备且存在信息不对称的情况下，市场均衡通常并非最优，即便政府不掌握额外信息，其干预也可能改善投资者福利。然而，政府干预的实际福利效应高度依赖于经济体的具体特征及政策设计。诸如价格稳定、市场流动性和信息效率等常见政策目标，可能对福利产生截然不同的影响。

title: Fiscal Multipliers during Natural Disasters
title_zh: 自然灾害期间的财政乘数
title_primary: 自然灾害期间的财政乘数
title_secondary: Fiscal Multipliers during Natural Disasters
authors: Andreas Dibiasi, Céline Poilly, Erica Perego
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Fiscal multipliers are larger during natural disasters. Using aggregate and state-level U.S. data, we show that the government-spending multiplier is significantly magnified when natural disasters occur. To rationalize this finding, we develop a New-Keynesian model augmented with disaster risk, in which higher public spending generates a larger output expansion through a strengthened investment channel. Two mechanisms are at work. First, by destroying productive capacity, a disaster raises the marginal productivity of capital, which further crowds in private investment. Second, wealth destruction leads households to draw down less of their savings in response to the fiscal shock, which boosts capital supply.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害期间财政乘数显著增大。基于美国全国及州级数据，我们发现当自然灾害发生时，政府支出乘数会显著放大。为解释这一现象，我们构建了纳入灾害风险的新凯恩斯模型，其中公共支出通过强化投资渠道产生更大的产出扩张效应。两种机制在发挥作用：其一，灾害破坏生产能力后，资本边际生产率提升，进而挤出私人投资；其二，财富损失导致家庭在面临财政冲击时减少储蓄消耗，从而增加资本供给。

title: An Informational Rationale for Viewpoint Neutrality in Education
title_zh: 教育中观点中立的信息学理据
title_primary: 教育中观点中立的信息学理据
title_secondary: An Informational Rationale for Viewpoint Neutrality in Education
authors: Georgy Egorov, Konstantin Sonin
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Consider a society that faces uncertainty about a payoff-relevant state and wants to train students to make correct decisions. In educational institutions, students learn from their teachers, but they also get outside information, and later learn from peers. We show that privately Bayesian actions need not be optimal inputs into social learning: when students' actions reflect teacher-side information that is correlated across peers, observing many such actions can give this information excessive social weight. A social planner may therefore optimally reduce the precision of instruction, inducing students to rely more on outside information before their actions become signals for others, and students can end up better informed despite learning less from their teachers. The case for a precision cap is stronger when peer interaction is homophilous, because same-teacher information is more likely to survive aggregation, and weaker when outside information is itself systematically distorted. This provides an informational rationale for viewpoint neutrality as an institutional policy: it limits the social overrepresentation of correlated teacher-side information when students mostly learn from peers exposed to similar sources.
abstract_zh: 考虑一个面临与收益相关状态不确定性的社会，其目标是培养学生做出正确决策。在教育机构中，学生从教师处学习，同时获取外部信息，并随后向同伴学习。研究表明，贝叶斯私人行动未必是社会学习的最优输入：当学生的行动反映了教师侧信息，且该信息在同伴间存在相关性时，观察大量此类行动可能导致该信息在社会层面被过度加权。因此，社会规划者可能最优地降低教学精度，促使学生在自身行动成为他人信号之前更多地依赖外部信息，最终学生虽从教师处学得更少，却能获得更充分的信息。当同伴互动呈现同质性时，支持精度上限的理由更为充分，因为源自同一教师的信息更易在聚合过程中存续；而当外部信息本身存在系统性偏差时，该理由则相对较弱。这为作为制度政策的观点中立性提供了信息层面的理论依据：当学生主要向接触相似信息来源的同伴学习时，该政策能够限制教师侧相关信息在社会层面的过度表征。

title: Helicopter drops in an open economy when markets are incomplete
title_zh: 不完全市场下开放经济中的直升机撒钱
title_primary: 不完全市场下开放经济中的直升机撒钱
title_secondary: Helicopter drops in an open economy when markets are incomplete
authors: Sara Eugeni
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We characterize the spillover effects of helicopter drops and optimal monetary policy in a tractable two‐country overlapping generations model with incomplete markets. As helicopter drops can affect the distribution of income across countries, they create room for redistribution policies which are particularly relevant when agents are heterogeneous and markets are incomplete. Under cooperation, central banks can implement the conditionally Pareto optimal allocation using helicopter drops (and suctions) to “lean against the wind.” In a non‐cooperative setting, helicopter drops exacerbate the incomplete markets' friction by making income more volatile. This paves the way for gains from cooperation.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个可处理的两国世代交叠模型（含不完全市场）中，刻画了直升机撒钱的溢出效应及最优货币政策。由于直升机撒钱可能影响国家间的收入分配，这为再分配政策创造了空间——当经济主体存在异质性且市场不完全时，此类政策尤为重要。在合作框架下，央行可通过直升机撒钱（及抽钱）实施条件帕累托最优配置，实现“逆风干预”。在非合作框架下，直升机撒钱会加剧收入波动，从而放大不完全市场的摩擦，这为合作收益的产生奠定了基础。

title: Price Connectedness in U.S. Biodiesel and Petroleum Diesel Markets
title_zh: 美国生物柴油与石油柴油市场的价格联动性
title_primary: 美国生物柴油与石油柴油市场的价格联动性
title_secondary: Price Connectedness in U.S. Biodiesel and Petroleum Diesel Markets
authors: Gerveni, Maria, Irwin, Scott H., Serra, Teresa
source: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study quantifies market integration across U.S. biodiesel plant-level and wholesale markets, as well as between biodiesel and petroleum diesel wholesale markets. Using Diebold-Yilmaz (2012, 2014) connectedness measures and a rolling window approach, we examine how price connectedness evolves across regions and supply chain levels. We find strong intra-supply chain integration within biodiesel markets and substantial cross-market integration between biodiesel and petroleum diesel wholesale markets. Connectedness declines sharply post-2022, coinciding with the renewable diesel boom as established supply chain interactions and regional price dynamics shift to reflect new market conditions.

title: Elite Universities and the Intergenerational Transmission of Human and Social Capital

authors: Andrés Barrios-Fernández, Christopher Neilson, Seth Zimmerman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do elite colleges help talented students join the social elite or help incumbent elites retain their positions? We combine intergenerationally linked data from Chile with a regression discontinuity design to show that, looking across generations, elite colleges do both. Lower-status individuals who gain admission to elite college programs transform their children’s social environment. Children become more likely to attend high-status private schools and colleges and to live near and befriend high-status peers. In contrast, academic achievement is unaffected. Simulations combining descriptive and quasi-experimental findings show that elite colleges tighten the link between social and human capital while decreasing intergenerational social mobility. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13)
abstract_zh: 精英大学是帮助有才华的学生跻身社会精英阶层，还是帮助现有精英维持其地位？我们结合智利的代际关联数据与断点回归设计发现，从代际视角来看，精英大学同时发挥了这两种作用。获得精英大学项目录取资格的低社会地位个体，其子女的社会环境发生了转变：子女更有可能进入高地位私立学校与大学，并与高地位同龄人居住相邻或建立友谊。相比之下，学业成绩并未受到影响。结合描述性与准实验研究结果的模拟分析表明，精英大学在降低代际社会流动性的同时，强化了社会资本与人力资本之间的关联。（JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13）

title: Do Mutual Funds Walk the Talk? Evidence from Fund Risk Disclosure
title_zh: 共同基金是否言行一致？来自基金风险披露的证据
title_primary: 共同基金是否言行一致？来自基金风险披露的证据
title_secondary: Do Mutual Funds Walk the Talk? Evidence from Fund Risk Disclosure
authors: Jinfei Sheng, Nan Xu, Lu Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the informativeness of fund risk disclosure by combining fund returns and textual data. We develop a novel measure, INF, to capture the explanatory power of disclosed risks for fund returns. Average INF is 55% after controlling for market risk and remains 26–29% after excluding risks related to fund name or strategy. We explain variations in INF through disclosure costs and benefits: (1) Funds with less informative disclosures face SEC comment letters and reduced flow, (2) informative disclosures attract institutional flows, and (3) performance concerns may disincentivize disclosure. Overall, funds face trade-offs between transparency and maintaining their competitive advantage. (JEL G12)
abstract_zh: 我们通过结合基金收益与文本数据，考察了基金风险披露的信息含量。我们构建了一个新颖的指标INF，用以衡量已披露风险对基金收益的解释力。在控制市场风险后，平均INF为55%；在剔除与基金名称或策略相关的风险后，该指标仍保持在26%至29%之间。我们通过披露成本与收益来解释INF的差异：（1）信息披露含量较低的基金会收到美国证券交易委员会的意见函，并面临资金流入减少；（2）信息含量高的披露能吸引机构资金流入；（3）业绩担忧可能抑制披露意愿。总体而言，基金在透明度与维持竞争优势之间面临权衡。（JEL G12）

abstract: Does the gender composition of high school peers affect whether students pursue a science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) major at university? Using administrative data from British Columbia, Canada, I exploit idiosyncratic within-school variation in gender composition. I find that having larger proportions of female peers has large and strong effects on students' STEM major choice. Such effects differ in both sign and magnitude across gender, high school type, and stage of high school education.
abstract_zh: 高中同伴的性别构成是否影响学生选择大学科学、技术、工程和数学（STEM）专业？利用加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省的行政数据，我利用校内性别构成的特殊变异。我发现，女性同伴比例较高对学生选择STEM专业有显著且强烈的影响。这种影响在性别、高中类型及高中教育阶段上，其方向和幅度均有所不同。

title: Unemployment‐Linked Food Hardships in Medicaid Expansion and Nonexpansion States During the COVID‐19 Pandemic
title_zh: 新冠疫情期间医疗补助扩展州与非扩展州的失业关联食品困境
title_primary: 新冠疫情期间医疗补助扩展州与非扩展州的失业关联食品困境

authors: Joseph Benitez, Katherine Yewell, Katie Fitzpatrick, Huang Huang
official: 官方在线 2026-03-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Job losses (e.g., layoffs, furloughs) during the COVID‐19 pandemic were associated with higher levels of food hardship including food insufficiency, marginal food insufficiency, and difficulty affording food. However, we find the association between pandemic‐related job loss and food hardship was smaller in states with expanded Medicaid eligibility compared against job losses in states that did not expand Medicaid. Our key findings are larger among higher‐income households and childless adults–groups generally beyond Medicaid's core low‐income population, and they suggest that Medicaid's value as an antipoverty program complements other safety net programs during periods of unexpected material hardship.
abstract_zh: 摘要 新冠疫情期间的工作损失（如裁员、停职）与更高水平的食物困难相关，包括食物不足、边缘性食物不足及难以负担食物。然而，我们发现，在扩大医疗补助资格的各州，疫情相关的工作损失与食物困难之间的关联，相较于未扩大医疗补助的各州，其影响较小。我们的主要发现在较高收入家庭和无子女成年人群体中更为显著——这些群体通常超出医疗补助核心低收入人群范围，这表明医疗补助作为反贫困项目的价值，在意外物质困难时期与其他安全网项目相辅相成。

title: Causal analysis of trade loss from pathogens: A global study of foot and mouth disease impacts on meat exports
title_zh: 病原体导致贸易损失的因果分析：口蹄疫对肉类出口影响的全球研究
title_primary: 病原体导致贸易损失的因果分析：口蹄疫对肉类出口影响的全球研究
title_secondary: Causal analysis of trade loss from pathogens: A global study of foot and mouth disease impacts on meat exports
authors: Mohammad Maksudur Rahman, Thomas L. Marsh
official: 官方在线 2026-02-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Our general interest is in global trade loss from livestock pathogens, specifically exports. We adopt a causal inference approach that considers animal disease outbreaks over time as non‐staggered binary treatments with the potential for switching in (infection) and out of treatment (recovery) within the sample period. The outcome evolution of switchers and non‐switchers identifies the treatment effects. Using a recently proposed dynamic difference‐in‐differences estimator, we estimate the treatment effects that decompose into “infected” (switch in) and “recovered” (switch out) effects. As a case study, we investigate the global impacts of foot and mouth disease outbreaks on meat exports using panel data across 178 countries from 1996 to 2016. We find that the outbreak decreases meat export by 19,000 to 48,000 metric tons per year (14% ‐ 35% of the mean annual meat export) in the 5 years following an outbreak, which is brought about by a decline in the infected countries' meat exports, while the disease‐recovered countries do not fully regain the export losses even after 5 years. The average total effect is estimated at about 54,000 metric tons per outbreak over 5 years following an outbreak, resulting in an export revenue loss of $141 million. Asymmetric post‐infection and post‐recovery trade losses imply a significant disease burden on the endemic regions. Regional decomposition of treatment effects reveals that while the magnitude of export loss is greater for the non‐endemic regions, the relative magnitude (compared to the mean annual export per country) is many times higher in the endemic regions.
abstract_zh: 我们的核心关注点在于牲畜病原体导致的全球贸易损失，特别是出口方面。我们采用因果推断方法，将样本期内动物疫病爆发视为非交错二元处理，并允许在处理状态（感染）与非处理状态（恢复）之间转换。通过比较转换者与非转换者的结果演变来识别处理效应。利用一种近期提出的动态双重差分估计器，我们估计了分解为“感染”（进入处理）和“恢复”（退出处理）效应的处理效应。作为案例研究，我们利用1996年至2016年间178个国家的面板数据，探讨了口蹄疫爆发对肉类出口的全球影响。研究发现，爆发后5年内，肉类出口每年减少19,000至48,000公吨（占年均肉类出口量的14%至35%），这源于感染国肉类出口的下降，而疫病恢复国即使在5年后也未能完全弥补出口损失。平均总效应估计为每次爆发后5年内约54,000公吨，导致出口收入损失达1.41亿美元。感染后与恢复后贸易损失的不对称性表明，地方性流行地区承受着显著的疾病负担。处理效应的区域分解显示，虽然非地方性流行地区的出口损失绝对值更大，但在地方性流行地区，相对损失（与各国年均出口量相比）高出数倍。

title: Adoption of Minimum Tillage and Mid‐Season Drainage in Rice Production and Their Impacts on Farm and Economic Performance
title_zh: 水稻生产中采用少耕与中期排水及其对农场和经济绩效的影响
title_primary: 水稻生产中采用少耕与中期排水及其对农场和经济绩效的影响
title_secondary: Adoption of Minimum Tillage and Mid‐Season Drainage in Rice Production and Their Impacts on Farm and Economic Performance
authors: Hongyun Zheng, Wanglin Ma
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2025-11-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the effects of two greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation practices—minimum tillage and mid‐season drainage—on rice farmers' farm performance (e.g., crop yield and risk) and economic outcomes (e.g., income and vulnerability). Minimum tillage reduces carbon dioxide emissions by preserving soil carbon and lowering machinery energy use, while mid‐season drainage reduces methane emissions by interrupting anaerobic conditions in rice paddies. We employ a multinomial endogenous switching regression model to analyse survey data collected from rice farmers in China. The results show that adopting mid‐season drainage alone significantly increases rice yield, while adopting minimum tillage—alone or combined with mid‐season drainage—reduces yield variance. In addition, adoption of either practice or both, substantially improves yield skewness, raises household income and reduces vulnerability to poverty. The findings highlight that promoting GHG mitigation practices like minimum tillage and mid‐season drainage requires emphasising their benefits in reducing production risks and poverty vulnerability, alongside their environmental impact, to encourage broader adoption among farmers.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了两种温室气体减排措施——少耕与中期排水——对稻农农场绩效（如作物产量与风险）及经济成果（如收入与脆弱性）的影响。少耕通过保持土壤碳含量和降低机械能耗来减少二氧化碳排放，而中期排水则通过中断稻田厌氧条件来减少甲烷排放。我们采用多元内生转换回归模型，分析了来自中国稻农的调查数据。结果显示，单独采用中期排水显著提高了水稻产量，而单独或结合中期排水采用少耕则降低了产量波动性。此外，采用任一措施或两者并用，均显著改善了产量偏度，提高了家庭收入，并降低了贫困脆弱性。研究结果强调，推广如少耕和中期排水等温室气体减排措施时，需着重强调其在降低生产风险与贫困脆弱性方面的益处，以及其环境影响，以促进农民更广泛的采纳。

title: The formation of consumer zero waste behaviour: the role of environmental attitudes, perceived marketplace influence, and perceived policy effectiveness
title_zh: 消费者零废弃行为的形成：环境态度、感知市场影响与感知政策有效性的作用
title_primary: 消费者零废弃行为的形成：环境态度、感知市场影响与感知政策有效性的作用
title_secondary: The formation of consumer zero waste behaviour: the role of environmental attitudes, perceived marketplace influence, and perceived policy effectiveness
authors: Bing-Qian Zhou, Ai-Zhong He
official: 官方在线 2025-10-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Consumers’ zero waste behaviour is a fundamental means of solving the problem of urban household waste. While the frontier literature focuses on the role of government and enterprise in achieving the goal of zero waste, it lacks focus on consumers, who are key players in generating household waste. In order to clarify the formation mechanism of consumers’ zero waste behaviours, this study integrates the Value-Attitude-Behaviour (VAB) theory and the perceived marketplace influence (PMI) theory, constructs a chain mediation model of the influence of environmental values on consumers’ zero waste behaviours, and explores the moderating role of perceived policy effectiveness. The study was conducted on 572 Chinese urban consumers through a field study held on 21 July 2023 to 21 August 2023. This study found that: (a) environmental values have a positive influence on zero waste behaviour,(b) environmental attitudes, perceived marketplace influence organization, and perceived marketplace influence consumer as chain mediators in the positive influence of environmental values on zero waste behaviour, (c) there is variability in the moderating role of perceived policy effectiveness in the mechanisms by which environmental values influence zero waste behaviour. The findings of this study enrich the research literature on consumer zero waste behaviour.

title: Irish regional GDP since independence
title_zh: 爱尔兰独立以来的区域GDP
title_primary: 爱尔兰独立以来的区域GDP
title_secondary: Irish regional GDP since independence
authors: Alan de Bromhead, Seán Kenny
official: 官方在线 2025-10-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper constructs the first long‐run estimates of Irish regional gross domestic product (GDP) over the twentieth century and traces the relative economic performance of Ireland's regions since independence. Using an array of data sources available at a county level, output in agriculture, industry, and services in benchmark census years is estimated. Applying a variety of alternative measures, we find a reduction in regional inequality over the period that resembles the broader European pattern. Regional convergence over the period 1926–91 was driven by both within‐sector convergence in productivity and structural change. Our paper helps us understand the regional dimensions of Irish economic development from the birth of a newly independent state up to the eve of Ireland's growth ‘miracle’ in the 1990s, when the first official efforts were initiated to construct these figures. Finally, we connect our regional estimates to the first official figures to study the evolution of Irish regional development up to 2021.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了二十世纪爱尔兰区域国内生产总值（GDP）的首个长期估算，并追溯了自独立以来爱尔兰各地区相对经济表现的演变。利用县级层面可获取的多种数据来源，估算了基准普查年份中农业、工业和服务业的产出。通过采用多种替代衡量指标，我们发现该时期区域不平等有所减少，这与更广泛的欧洲模式相似。1926年至1991年间的区域趋同既受部门内生产率趋同的驱动，也受结构变化的推动。本文有助于我们理解从新独立国家诞生至20世纪90年代爱尔兰增长“奇迹”前夕这一时期的区域经济发展维度，当时首次官方统计工作已启动以构建这些数据。最后，我们将区域估算与首批官方数据相衔接，以研究直至2021年爱尔兰区域发展的演变过程。
